summary: A permit for a larger shop raises a question about rainwater from the new pavement.
realLife: Tigard’s commission linked added hard surfaces at the Dolan site to runoff into Fanno Creek, whose drainage basin was already under strain.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with shop, creek, parking lot. A drainage finding can bring a shop permit into a conversation downstream.

turns.what: A revised drawing sends runoff from the roof to storage but leaves the lot draining to the creek.
turns.pulledBy: The site engineer can separate the two drainage areas.
turns.writesBack: The next drainage finding covers the parking lot.

turns.what: A shop downstream sends photographs from the first storm after the new lot opens.
turns.pulledBy: The photographs are dated and show water at the shop threshold, with no measurement of its source.
turns.writesBack: The drainage file logs the complaint and requests a site inspection.
